title: Stiff ODEs & Multistep Methods
description: Stability regions, A-stability, implicit methods, Adams and BDF methods.
html:
⚡ Stiff ODEs & Multistep Methods

1. Test Equation and Stability

$$y' = \lambda y,\ \mathrm{Re}\,\lambda < 0: \qquad y_{k+1} = R(z)\,y_k,\ z = h\lambda; \quad \text{stable} \iff |R(z)| \le 1$$

Example $y' = -50y$, $h = 0.05$ ($z = -2.5$)

Explicit Euler $R = 1 + z = -1.5$: oscillation and explosion; needed $h \le \frac{2}{50} = 0.04$. Implicit Euler $R = \frac{1}{1 - z} = 0.2857$: stable for all $h$.

  • $R_{\text{Euler expl.}} = 1 + z$, $R_{\text{Heun}} = 1 + z + \frac{z^2}{2}$, $R_{\text{RK4}} = \sum_{j\le4}\frac{z^j}{j!}$ (real: $[-2,0]$, $[-2,0]$, $[-2.785,0]$).
  • $R_{\text{Euler impl.}} = \frac{1}{1-z}$, $R_{\text{trapezoid}} = \frac{1 + z/2}{1 - z/2}$.

2. Stability Regions, A-/L-Stability, Stiffness

  • Explicit Euler: disc around $-1$. Implicit Euler: outside the disc around $+1$. Trapezoidal rule: left half-plane.
  • A-stable: region $\supseteq$ left half-plane. L-stable: additionally $R(-\infty) = 0$ (implicit Euler yes, trapezoid no).
  • Stiff: $\max|\mathrm{Re}\,\lambda|/\min|\mathrm{Re}\,\lambda|$ large ⇒ explicit methods need tiny $h$.
  • Implicit: per step a linear system or Newton's method (4.8): $(I - h\,\partial f/\partial y)\Delta = -G$.

3. Multistep Methods

$$\text{AB2: } y_{k+1} = y_k + \tfrac h2(3f_k - f_{k-1}), \quad \text{AM2: } y_{k+1} = y_k + \tfrac h2(f_{k+1} + f_k), \quad \text{BDF2: } y_{k+1} - \tfrac43y_k + \tfrac13y_{k-1} = \tfrac23hf_{k+1}$$

  • Starting values from a one-step method of the same order; predictor–corrector (AB2 + AM2).
  • Convergence = consistency + zero-stability (root condition for $\rho$). Dahlquist barriers: A-stable ⇒ order $\le 2$.
  • Adams for non-stiff, BDF for stiff problems.

4. Typical Mistakes

  • Confusing stability with accuracy (high order ≠ large stable step size).
  • Forgetting the absolute value in $R(z)$ ($|R(z)| \le 1$, not $R \le 1$).
  • Determining starting values for multistep methods with too low an order.
